investigation_notes.Decoded Payloads: Subdomain fragments decode to: 'filename=shadow.bak', 'chunk=01|data=Hello%', 'chunk=02|data=20world', 'chunk=03|data=exfil' which reassemble into chunked data referencing a file and an apparent exfil payload.
investigation_notes.Description: An unusually large volume of high-entropy TXT DNS traffic was observed targeting update-check-cdn.xyz, with the query payloads containing base64-like subdomains. Decoded fragments reveal a filename ('shadow.bak') and chunked data segments ('Hello%','20world','exfil'), which are consistent with encoded data being transferred via DNS. The root domain is newly registered (~29 days old) and, combined with the high byte count and embedded filename, this activity is indicative of potential DNS-based exfiltration and warrants higher-priority handling.
